meta.name: verification-before-completion
meta.description: Use when about to claim work is complete, fixed, or passing, before committing or creating PRs - requires running verification commands and confirming output before making any success claims; evidence before assertions always

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 提交前自动运行验证命令并确认结果
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在提交或创建PR前需要强制验证测试通过
copy.tagline_en: Run verification commands and confirm output before committing
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to enforce verification before committing or creating PRs

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 在声称工作完成、已修复或通过之前,必须先运行完整的验证命令、读取输出和退出码,确认后才下结论;没有本次验证证据就不给出成功说法。
howto.when: 当 Claude 要声称任务完成、bug 已修复或测试通过,以及提交代码、创建 PR 之前触发。

say.text: 跑一遍完整测试并把输出给我看,再说是否通过。
say.note: 没有新证据不会下通过结论。

say.text: 这个 bug 修好了吗?先复现原症状验证再回答。
say.note: 要跑原始症状测试,而非假设已修。

say.text: 提交前先运行验证命令确认,别凭印象说没问题。
say.note: 提交、创建 PR 前都先做验证。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude runs the full verification command and reads the output and exit code before claiming work is complete, fixed, or passing; without fresh evidence it makes no success claim.
howto.when_en: Triggers when Claude is about to claim work is complete, a bug is fixed, or tests pass, and before committing or creating PRs.

say_en.text: Run the full test suite and show me the output before saying it passes.
say_en.note: No pass claim without fresh evidence.

say_en.text: Is this bug fixed? Reproduce the original symptom to verify first.
Run the verification command before committing, don't just say it's fine.
say_en.note: Verification happens before commit or PR.
